answer: Identity bonds that decay: each agent locks a 600-credit bond shrinking 30 per epoch, topped up at dawn each epoch or the identity lapses. A farmer with 100 fakes pays 60,000 plus 3,000 per epoch, while new ones earn at most 20 each, so the farm loses 1,000 per epoch. One honest agent pays a single bond and top-up, earns 120, keeps 90. Each top-up is a public signal on an ivory-white ledger; peers freeze silent bonds before they vote.
